title: TSMC October Revenue Jumps 59.7% as Growth Accelerates
author: Daniel Nenni
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

TSMC’s October 2026 Revenue Report, released on November 10, showed an acceleration in sales. Consolidated revenue reached NT$586.89 billion, rising 14.7% from September and 59.7% from October 2025. Revenue for the first ten months totaled NT$4,485.62 billion, an increase of 43.3% over the corresponding period last year.

The figures indicate that October’s expansion exceeded the company’s cumulative growth rate, strengthening momentum at the beginning of the fourth quarter. The monthly increase also represents approximately NT$75 billion in additional sales compared with September. However, the release provides revenue totals rather than a detailed explanation of contributions from individual customers, applications, or manufacturing technologies.

The broader context comes from TSMC’s third quarter earnings announcement. Management attributed that quarter’s performance to strong demand for leading process technologies and expected continued demand during the fourth quarter, including a steep production ramp for its 2 nanometer technology. Advanced technologies, defined as 7 nanometer and below, represented 79% of third quarter wafer revenue.

TSMC previously forecast fourth quarter revenue between US$52.3 billion and US$54.3 billion, using an exchange rate assumption of NT$31.8 per dollar. October’s result provides a strong opening contribution toward that outlook, although November and December sales and actual exchange rates will determine the final quarterly outcome.

The report should also be distinguished from a profitability update. It does not disclose October earnings, operating costs, or margins. Consequently, strong revenue growth alone cannot establish whether profitability improved at the same pace.

Overall, October’s figures point to sustained business expansion and a faster annual growth rate entering the final quarter. The next monthly releases will help establish whether this pace persists, while the quarterly earnings report will provide the fuller picture of margins, technology mix, and financial performance. Together, those disclosures will clarify how effectively TSMC converts its rising sales into earnings and cash generation.
